BiblicalUsage: Beerah is a prince of the Reubenites, the son of Baal. He is carried away captive by Tiglath-pileser the king of Assyria.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Beerah's captivity is the end of Reuben's pride, because the firstborn tribe loses its prince to Assyria.
